package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestTechnicalTaskV1SerializationRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
	payload, err := json.Marshal(task)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := DecodeTechnicalTaskV1(payload)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode: %v", err)
	}
	encodedAgain, err := json.Marshal(decoded)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(encodedAgain) != string(payload) {
		t.Fatalf("round trip changed contract:\n%s\n%s", payload, encodedAgain)
	}
}

func TestDecodeTechnicalTaskV1SortsStepsByExplicitOrder(t *testing.T) {
	task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
	task.Steps[0], task.Steps[1] = task.Steps[1], task.Steps[0]
	payload, err := json.Marshal(task)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := DecodeTechnicalTaskV1(payload)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode: %v", err)
	}
	if decoded.Steps[0].ID != "create-handler" || decoded.Steps[1].ID != "register-route" {
		t.Fatalf("steps were not canonicalized by explicit order: %+v", decoded.Steps)
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1RejectsInvalidSchemaAndVersion(t *testing.T) {
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*TechnicalTaskV1){
		"schema":  func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) { task.Schema = "technical-task.v2" },
		"version": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) { task.SchemaVersion = 2 },
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
			mutate(&task)
			if err := task.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDecodeTechnicalTaskV1RejectsUnknownFields(t *testing.T) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(validTechnicalTaskV1())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var document map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &document); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	document["future_field"] = true
	payload, err = json.Marshal(document)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := DecodeTechnicalTaskV1(payload); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected strict validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1RejectsDuplicateAndConflictingStepOrder(t *testing.T) {
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*TechnicalTaskV1){
		"duplicate id": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[1].ID = task.Steps[0].ID
		},
		"duplicate order": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[1].Order = task.Steps[0].Order
		},
		"forward dependency": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[0].Dependencies = []string{task.Steps[1].ID}
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
			mutate(&task)
			if err := task.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1RejectsDuplicateConceptAndUncoveredOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*TechnicalTaskV1){
		"duplicate concept": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Concepts = append(task.Concepts, task.Concepts[0])
		},
		"uncovered outcome": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Verification[0].ExpectedResultIDs = nil
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
			mutate(&task)
			if err := task.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1RejectsInvalidMilestoneGraph(t *testing.T) {
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*TechnicalTaskV1){
		"inconsistent metadata": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[0].MilestoneID, task.Steps[0].MilestoneOrder = "milestone-one", 1
			task.Steps[1].MilestoneID, task.Steps[1].MilestoneOrder = "milestone-one", 2
		},
		"forward dependency": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[0].MilestoneID, task.Steps[0].MilestoneOrder = "milestone-one", 1
			task.Steps[0].MilestoneDependencies = []string{"milestone-two"}
			task.Steps[1].MilestoneID, task.Steps[1].MilestoneOrder = "milestone-two", 2
		},
		"partial metadata": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[0].MilestoneOrder = 1
		},
		"steps conflict with milestone order": func(task *TechnicalTaskV1) {
			task.Steps[0].MilestoneID, task.Steps[0].MilestoneOrder = "milestone-two", 2
			task.Steps[0].MilestoneDependencies = []string{"milestone-one"}
			task.Steps[1].MilestoneID, task.Steps[1].MilestoneOrder = "milestone-one", 1
		},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
			mutate(&task)
			if err := task.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1RejectsUnsafeAction(t *testing.T) {
	task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
	task.Steps[0].Actions = []TaskActionV1{{Type: TaskActionCreateFile, Path: "../solution.go"}}
	if err := task.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1SupportsTypedHTTPResultAndVerification(t *testing.T) {
	task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
	task.ExpectedResult = ExpectedResultV1{
		Type: ExpectedResultHTTPEndpoint,
		HTTP: &HTTPExpectedResultV1{ID: "health-response", Method: "get", Path: "/health", Status: 200, ContentType: "Application/JSON", Body: json.RawMessage(`{"status":"ok"}`)},
	}
	for index := range task.Steps {
		task.Steps[index].ExpectedResultIDs = []string{"health-response"}
	}
	task.Verification = []TaskVerificationV1{{
		ID: "check-health", Type: "http_request", Visibility: "private", ExpectedResultIDs: []string{"health-response"},
		HTTP: &HTTPVerificationV1{Method: "get", Path: "/health"},
	}}
	if err := task.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("typed HTTP contract rejected: %v", err)
	}
	if task.ExpectedResult.HTTP.Method != "GET" || task.ExpectedResult.HTTP.ContentType != "application/json" || task.Verification[0].HTTP.Method != "GET" {
		t.Fatalf("typed HTTP contract was not normalized: %+v", task)
	}
}

func TestTechnicalTaskV1RejectsContradictingTypedVerification(t *testing.T) {
	task := validTechnicalTaskV1()
	task.ExpectedResult = ExpectedResultV1{
		Type: ExpectedResultHTTPEndpoint,
		HTTP: &HTTPExpectedResultV1{ID: "health-response", Method: "GET", Path: "/health", Status: 200},
	}
	for index := range task.Steps {
		task.Steps[index].ExpectedResultIDs = []string{"health-response"}
	}
	task.Verification = []TaskVerificationV1{{
		ID: "check-health", Type: "http_request", Visibility: "private", ExpectedResultIDs: []string{"health-response"},
		HTTP: &HTTPVerificationV1{Method: "GET", Path: "/ready"},
	}}
	if err := task.Validate(); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestStudentTechnicalTaskViewContainsOnlyPublicInstruction(t *testing.T) {
	view := validTechnicalTaskV1().StudentView()
	payload, err := json.Marshal(view)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	serialized := string(payload)
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"steps", "hints", "actions", "verification", "concepts", "private_evaluation", "solution"} {
		if strings.Contains(serialized, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("student view leaked %q: %s", forbidden, serialized)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(serialized, "Добавьте health endpoint") || !strings.Contains(serialized, "GET /health") {
		t.Fatalf("student instruction missing: %s", serialized)
	}
}

func validTechnicalTaskV1() TechnicalTaskV1 {
	target := LearningTargetRef{Type: "capability", Key: "go.http-routing", Version: "v1"}
	return TechnicalTaskV1{
		Schema: TechnicalTaskSchemaV1, SchemaVersion: TechnicalTaskSchemaVersionV1,
		Goal: "Реализовать endpoint состояния приложения",
		StudentInstruction: StudentInstructionV1{
			Title: "Добавьте health endpoint", Description: "Создайте публичную проверку состояния приложения.",
			Requirements: []StudentRequirementV1{{ID: "req-health", Text: "Endpoint GET /health возвращает успешный JSON-ответ"}},
		},
		ExpectedResult: ExpectedResultV1{
			Type:     ExpectedResultAcceptanceContract,
			Outcomes: []ExpectedOutcomeV1{{ID: "acc-health", Description: "GET /health отвечает status=ok", EvidenceKind: "deterministic"}},
		},
		Concepts: []TaskConceptV1{{Target: target, Role: ConceptRoleRequired}},
		Steps: []TechnicalTaskStepV1{
			{ID: "create-handler", Order: 1, Goal: "Создать обработчик", Deliverables: []string{"HTTP handler"}, ConceptRefs: []LearningTargetRef{target}, ExpectedResultIDs: []string{"acc-health"}, VerificationIDs: []string{"check-health"}, EstimatedEffortMinutes: 20, Hints: []TaskHintV1{{Level: 1, Text: "Начните с обработчика запроса."}}},
			{ID: "register-route", Order: 2, Goal: "Подключить маршрут", Dependencies: []string{"create-handler"}, Deliverables: []string{"Маршрут GET /health"}, ConceptRefs: []LearningTargetRef{target}, ExpectedResultIDs: []string{"acc-health"}, VerificationIDs: []string{"check-health"}, EstimatedEffortMinutes: 15},
		},
		Verification: []TaskVerificationV1{{ID: "check-health", Type: "runtime", Visibility: "private", ExpectedResultIDs: []string{"acc-health"}, ExecutionContractRef: "private_evaluation.code_structure"}},
	}
}
